/subscribed/subtitle.v: Tarisai bhokisi renyu reemail kuti muone email yekusimbisa.

/form/intro.v: Zvinyorwa zvitsva zvinouya ne-email, zvakanyorwa nemutauro wamunosarudza.

/form/nameHint.v: Tinorishandisa kukukwazisai. Mukarisiya risina chinhu, tinoshandisa kutanga kwekero yenyu ye-email.

/form/languageHint.v: Takasarudza izvi kubva pamasetingi ebrowser yenyu.

/form/consent.v: Nekunyoresa, munobvuma kugamuchira maemail kubva ku{sender}. Email yega yega ine link yekumisa kunyoresa.

/success/body.v: Tatumira email yekusimbisa ku{email}. Ivhurei mosarudza Simbisa kunyoresa.

/success/next.v: Chinyorwa chenyu chekutanga chichauya mushure mekunge masimbisa, chakanyorwa mu{language}.

/success/spam.v: Kana pasina chinouya mukati memaminitsi mashoma, tarisai muforodha ye-spam kana Promotions.

/errors/emailInvalid.v: Kero ye-email iyi inoita seisina kukwana. Itarisei moedza zvakare.

/errors/missingLink.v: Link yekunyoresa iyi haina ruzivo rwakakwana. Kumbirai link itsva kumutumiri.

/errors/notFound.v: Link yekunyoresa iyi haichashandi. Kumbirai link itsva kumutumiri.

/errors/limit.v: Tsamba remashoko iri harigoni kugamuchira vanyoresi vatsva parizvino. Edzai zvakare gare gare.

/errors/invalid.v: Hatina kukwanisa kugamuchira kero iyi. Itarisei moedza zvakare.

/errors/server.v: Hatina kukwanisa kuchengeta kunyoresa kwenyu. Edzai zvakare kwapera chinguva.

/errors/network.v: Hatina kukwanisa kusvika pa-server. Tarisai kubatana kwenyu moedza zvakare.

/confirm/body.v: Sarudzai bhatani kuti mutange kugamuchira zvinyorwa pa{email}.

/confirm/consent.v: Nekusimbisa, munobvuma kugamuchira tsamba remashoko iri ne-email. Munogona kumisa kunyoresa kubva pachinyorwa chipi zvacho.

/confirm/successTip.v: Kuti zvisapinda mu-spam, wedzerai mutumiri kuvanhu vamunotaura navo.

/confirm/invalidBody.v: Vhurai zvakare email yekusimbisa mosarudza bhatani rayo. Kana musingaiwani, nyoresai zvakare kubva papeji yemutumiri.

/confirm/notFoundBody.v: Hatina kuwana kunyoresa kwekero iyi. Nyoresai zvakare kubva papeji yemutumiri.

/confirm/errorBody.v: Hatina kukwanisa kusimbisa kunyoresa kwenyu. Edzai zvakare kwapera chinguva.

/embed/intro.v: Namatidzai imwe yemakodhi aya pawebhusaiti yenyu. Vanhu vanonyoresa vanogamuchira email yekusimbisa, vozogamuchira zvinyorwa zvenyu nemutauro wavo.

/embed/linkHint.v: Igovanei mu-bio yesocial media, siginecha ye-email, kana kodhi ye-QR.

/embed/scriptHint.v: Inamatidzei panofanira kuoneka fomu. Fomu inozvigadzirisa saizi yayo pachayo.

/embed/iframeHint.v: Shandisai iyi kana webhusaiti yenyu isingabvumiri ma-script.

/embed/accentHint.v: Rusiyei sezvarwuri kuti mushandise ruvara rwebhurandi yenyu.

/embed/previewNote.v: Kutarisa uku kunoshanda chaizvo. Kunyoresa pano kunogadzira munyoresi chaiye.

/embed/missing.v: Gadzirai tsamba remashoko kutanga. Fomu yekunyoresa ichaoneka pano kana iripo.

/signature/intro.v: Vaverengi vanoona izvi pakupera kwechinyorwa chimwe nechimwe. Dzvanyai chikamu chipi zvacho chekutarisa kuti muchigadzirise.

/signature/show.v: Ratidza siginecha yangu muchinyorwa chimwe nechimwe

/signature/previewEmpty.v: Siginecha yenyu haina chinhu. Wedzerai zita renyu kuti mutange.

/signature/blocksHint.v: Sarudzai tagi kuti muratidze kana kuvanza chikamu ichocho. Zvikamu zvakavanzwa zvinochengeta mavara azvo.

/signature/hints/photoUrl.v: Link kuPNG kana JPG ine mativi akaenzana, ingangoita 144 x 144 pixels uye iri pasi pe200 KB. Inoratidzwa pa72 x 72 pixels padivi pezita renyu.

/signature/hints/logoUrl.v: Link kuPNG kana JPG ine kumashure kunoonekera kana kuchena, ingangoita 64 pixels kureba. Inoratidzwa ichireba 32 pixels.

/signature/hints/cta.v: Mavara ne-link zvese zvinodiwa kuti bhatani rionekwe.

/signature/hints/disclaimer.v: Mavara madiki pazasi, semuenzaniso chiziviso chekuvanzika. Siyai pasina chinhu kana musingachidi.

/signature/style/accentHint.v: Runoshandiswa pamutsetse, ma-link nebhatani. Runotanga neruvara rwebhurandi yenyu.

/signature/resetConfirm.v: Sarudzai zvakare kuti mudzime minda yese
